problem: A picker returning after comparison closure modified cleared paths or status. A single returned image after destruction accessed an already deleted QLabel.
change: Check Qt validity, the existing closed state and owner lifetime before opening the picker and before consuming its results.

reproduction.cases: One or two paths returned after rejection, with or without destruction.

coverage: Four closure cases preserve cleared paths and requests, avoid starting work or changing status, and refuse picker reentry.
Cancelling selection preserves decoded red/blue images and status; retrying decodes green/white images and updates displayed filenames.
Existing comparison rendering, latest-request handling and close-time cancellation remain covered.

limitations: Offscreen Qt tests substitute picker return values.
Full regression, independent review and integration remain pending. Native checks do not cover OS keyboard input or the real file picker.

native.platform: Windows private desktop, Traditional_Chinese, dark, 900x740 main window
native.entry: Actual image page open_image_compare; widget-local Space on the focused choose button, with Tab navigation available. Picker results substituted.
